title: Was Louis an Uncle Tom? Louis as entertainer
summary: Joe rejects the Uncle Tom charge and calls Louis the greatest entertainer, being asked by fans if he was Louis Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Do you think that Louis was an Uncle Tom ever?

No, sir! Not by any stretch of the imagination to my idea. Louis never was an Uncle Tom. Louis was just a nice guy. Louis did all those things because he loved to do 'em, not because he was an Uncle Tom. But to me, Louis was the greatest entertainer that ever lived. He could do it all, to my idea. He was a terrific actor, and his voice, the way he'd sing -- everybody liked his singing. And needless to say, his blowing.

Did you ever hear this story... I forget who did it. Somebody wrote this story up. They went out and they asked the first ten people they met in the street, "Who is Louis Armstrong?" They just stopped the first ten passers-by. The first guy said, "Oh, he's a trumpet player," another one said, "Oh, he's a singer," another one "Oh, he's a comedian," and another one said, "Well, he's a movie star," and another one said... You know, all the way

There was only one of them who said, 'I don't know; I've never heard of him.' But the funny thing was that nine out of ten people were right, and they all said nine different things, because he was all of the... Do you understand what I mean?
He was all those things. So ten people, nine of them gave different answers, but they were all right.
Yeah. To show you how misinformed a lot of people were when we played... I got off the bus, and a guy says, 'Are you Louis Armstrong?' And they'd ask Billy Kyle sometimes, you know...
